fyear_data = (
    funda_mod
    .select("fyear", "datadate")
    .unique()
    .filter(pl.col("fyear").is_not_null())
    .with_columns(
        month=pl.col("datadate").dt.month(),
        year=pl.col("datadate").dt.year(),
    )
    .collect()
)

def ols_fit(formula, data):
    return smf.ols(formula, data=data.to_pandas()).fit()

fms = [ols_fit(form, fyear_data)
       for form in ["fyear ~ C(month) + year - 1",
                    "fyear ~ month + year"]]

fyear_plot_data = (
    fyear_data
    .with_columns(
        pred_1=pl.Series("pred_1", fms[0].predict(fyear_data.to_pandas())),
        pred_2=pl.Series("pred_2", fms[1].predict(fyear_data.to_pandas())),
    )
    .with_columns(
        resid_1=pl.col("pred_1") - pl.col("fyear"),
        resid_2=pl.col("pred_2") - pl.col("fyear"),
    )
)

#| include: false
#| eval: true
n_qtrs = 20
n_firms = 70
focus_years = [1974, 2019]
sic2s = [f"{x:02d}" for x in [29, 49, 28, 35, 32, 33,
                              37, 20, 26, 10, 36, 59]]

companies = (
    company
    .with_columns(sic2=pl.col("sic").cast(pl.String).str.slice(0, 2))
    .filter(pl.col("sic2").is_in(sic2s))
    .select("gvkey", "sic2")
)

fundq_merged = (
    fundq_mod
    .join(companies.select("gvkey"), on="gvkey", how="semi")
    .filter(pl.col("saleq") > 0,
            pl.col("saleq").is_not_null()
    )
    .select("gvkey", "datadate", "fyr", "fqtr", "fyearq",
            "rdq", "niq", "saleq", "ibq")
    .rename({"datadate": "datadateq"})
)

firm_years = (
    funda_mod
    .select("gvkey", "datadate")
)

merged_data = (
    firm_years
    .join(link_table,
          on=["gvkey", "datadate"],
          how="inner")
    .join(fundq_merged,
          on=["gvkey", "datadateq", "fyearq", "fyr"],
          how="inner")
)

qtr_num = (
    merged_data
    .group_by("gvkey", "datadate")
    .agg(num_quarters=pl.len())
)

regular_fyears = (
    firm_years
    .join(qtr_num, on=["gvkey", "datadate"], how="inner")
    .sort("gvkey", "datadate")
    .with_columns(
        fyear_length=(pl.col("datadate") - pl.col("datadate")
                      .shift(1).over("gvkey"))
                      .dt.total_days()
    )
    .with_columns(
        regular_year=(
            (pl.col("num_quarters") == 4)
            & (pl.col("fyear_length").is_null() |
                  pl.col("fyear_length").is_in([365, 366]))
        )
    )
    .filter(pl.col("regular_year"))
    .select("gvkey", "datadate")
)

reg_data = (
    merged_data
    .join(companies.select("gvkey"), on="gvkey", how="semi")
    .join(regular_fyears, on=["gvkey", "datadate"], how="semi")
    .select("gvkey", "datadateq", "fyearq", "rdq", "niq", "saleq")
    .sort("gvkey", "datadateq")
    .with_columns(
        sale_lag_1=pl.col("saleq").shift(1).over("gvkey"),
        sale_lag_4=pl.col("saleq").shift(4).over("gvkey"),
        sale_lag_5=pl.col("saleq").shift(5).over("gvkey"),
        ni_lag_1=pl.col("niq").shift(1).over("gvkey"),
        ni_lag_4=pl.col("niq").shift(4).over("gvkey"),
        ni_lag_5=pl.col("niq").shift(5).over("gvkey"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        sale_diff=pl.col("saleq") - pl.col("sale_lag_1"),
        sale_seas_diff=pl.col("saleq") - pl.col("sale_lag_4"),
        ni_diff=pl.col("niq") - pl.col("ni_lag_1"),
        ni_seas_diff=pl.col("niq") - pl.col("ni_lag_4"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        lag_sale_seas_diff=pl.col("sale_seas_diff").shift(1).over("gvkey"),
        lag_ni_seas_diff=pl.col("ni_seas_diff").shift(1).over("gvkey"),
    )
    .collect()
)

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
def fit_model(gvkey, datadateq):

    firm_data = (
        reg_data
        .filter(pl.col("gvkey") == gvkey)
        .sort("datadateq")
    )

    train_data = (
        firm_data
        .filter(pl.col("datadateq") < datadateq)
        .tail(n_qtrs)
    )
    if train_data.height < n_qtrs:
        return None

    test_data = firm_data.filter(pl.col("datadateq") == datadateq)
    if test_data.height == 0:
        return None

    model_24 = train_data.select(
        pl.col("sale_diff", "ni_diff", "sale_seas_diff", "ni_seas_diff")
        .mean()
    ).to_dicts()[0]

    df = test_data.with_columns(
        ni_m1=pl.col("ni_lag_4"),
        sale_m1=pl.col("sale_lag_4"),
        ni_m2=pl.col("ni_lag_4") + pl.lit(model_24["ni_seas_diff"]),
        sale_m2=pl.col("sale_lag_4") + pl.lit(model_24["sale_seas_diff"]),
        ni_m3=pl.col("ni_lag_1"),
        sale_m3=pl.col("sale_lag_1"),
        ni_m4=pl.col("ni_lag_1") + pl.lit(model_24["ni_diff"]),
        sale_m4=pl.col("sale_lag_1") + pl.lit(model_24["sale_diff"]),
    )

    try:
        train_pd = train_data.to_pandas()
        test_pd = test_data.to_pandas()
        sale_fm5 = smf.ols("sale_seas_diff ~ lag_sale_seas_diff",
                           data=train_pd).fit()
        ni_fm5 = smf.ols("ni_seas_diff ~ lag_ni_seas_diff",
                         data=train_pd).fit()
        sale_fm6 = smf.ols("saleq ~ sale_lag_1 + sale_lag_4 + sale_lag_5",
                           data=train_pd).fit()
        ni_fm6 = smf.ols("niq ~ ni_lag_1 + ni_lag_4 + ni_lag_5",
                         data=train_pd).fit()
    except Exception:
        return None

    df = df.with_columns(
        ni_m5=pl.col("ni_lag_4") +
                  pl.Series("ni_m5_pred", ni_fm5.predict(test_pd)),
        sale_m5=pl.col("sale_lag_4") +
                    pl.Series("sale_m5_pred", sale_fm5.predict(test_pd)),
        ni_m6=pl.Series("ni_m6_pred", ni_fm6.predict(test_pd)),
        sale_m6=pl.Series("sale_m6_pred", sale_fm6.predict(test_pd)),
    )

    out = (
        df.select(["gvkey", "datadateq", "fyearq", "niq", "saleq"] +
                  [f"{x}_m{i}" for i in range(1, 7)
                   for x in ["ni", "sale"]])
        .unpivot(
            index=["gvkey", "datadateq", "fyearq", "niq", "saleq"],
            on=[f"{x}_m{i}" for i in range(1, 7)
                for x in ["ni", "sale"]],
            variable_name="item_model",
            value_name="predicted",
        )
        .with_columns(
            item=pl.col("item_model").str.split("_m").list.get(0),
            model=pl.col("item_model").str.split("_m").list.get(1),
        )
        .with_columns(
            actual=pl.when(pl.col("item") == "ni")
                     .then(pl.col("niq"))
                     .otherwise(pl.col("saleq")),
        )
        .with_columns(
            abe=(pl.col("predicted") - pl.col("actual")).abs() /
                    pl.col("predicted"),
        )
        .with_columns(
            se=(pl.col("abe") ** 2) * pl.col("predicted").sign(),
        )
        .drop("niq", "saleq", "item_model")
    )
    return out

top_firms = (
    reg_data
    .filter(pl.col("fyearq").is_in(focus_years))
    .group_by("gvkey", "fyearq")
    .agg(total_sales=pl.col("saleq").sum())
    .sort("fyearq", "total_sales", descending=[False, True])
    .group_by("fyearq", maintain_order=True)
    .head(n_firms)
)

test_years = (
    reg_data
    .join(top_firms.select("gvkey", "fyearq"),
          on=["gvkey", "fyearq"], how="semi")
    .select("gvkey", "datadateq")
    .unique()
)

def fix_outliers(expr: pl.Expr) -> pl.Expr:
    return (
        pl.when((expr < 0) | (expr > 1))
        .then(1.0)
        .otherwise(expr)
        .name.keep()
    )
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
reg_data_fos = (
    merged_data
    .join(regular_fyears, on=["gvkey", "datadate"], how="semi")
    .select("gvkey", "datadateq", "fyearq", "rdq", "ibq")
    .sort("gvkey", "datadateq")
    .with_columns(
        ib_lag_4=pl.col("ibq").shift(4).over("gvkey"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        ib_seas_diff=pl.col("ibq") - pl.col("ib_lag_4"),
        qtr=(
            pl.col("datadateq").dt.year()
            + pl.col("datadateq").dt.quarter() / 10
        ),
    )
    .with_columns(
        lag_ib_seas_diff=pl.col("ib_seas_diff").shift(1).over("gvkey"),
    )
    .collect()
)

def fast_ols_predict(train_df, test_df, y_col, x_col):
    train_clean = train_df.select(y_col, x_col).drop_nulls()
    if train_clean.height == 0:
        return None

    y = train_clean[y_col].to_numpy()
    x = train_clean[x_col].to_numpy()
    y_mean = y.mean()

    if train_clean.height == 1 or np.all(x == x[0]):
        return pl.Series("pred", np.full(test_df.height, y_mean),
                         nan_to_null=True)

    X = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x), x])
    beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)

    test_x = test_df[x_col].to_numpy()
    X_test = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(test_x, dtype=float), test_x])
    pred = X_test @ beta
    pred[np.isnan(test_x)] = np.nan

    return pl.Series("pred", pred, nan_to_null=True)


def fit_model_fos(gvkey, quarter):
    n_qtrs = 24
    min_qtrs_fos = 16
    min_qtrs = 10

    firm_data = (
        reg_data_fos
        .filter(pl.col("gvkey") == gvkey)
        .sort("datadateq")
    )

    train_data = (
        firm_data
        .filter(pl.col("qtr") < quarter)
        .tail(n_qtrs)
    )
    if train_data.height < min_qtrs:
        return None

    test_data = firm_data.filter(pl.col("qtr") == quarter)

    if train_data.height >= min_qtrs_fos:
        train_results = train_data.with_columns(
            fib=pl.col("ib_lag_4") + fast_ols_predict(
                    train_data, train_data,
                    "ib_seas_diff", "lag_ib_seas_diff"
                )
        )
        test_results = test_data.with_columns(
            fib=pl.col("ib_lag_4") + fast_ols_predict(
                    train_data, test_data,
                    "ib_seas_diff", "lag_ib_seas_diff"
                )
        )
    else:
        train_results = train_data.with_columns(fib=pl.col("ib_lag_4"))
        test_results = test_data.with_columns(fib=pl.col("ib_lag_4"))

    denom_m2 = (
        train_results
        .select(
            pl.when((pl.col("ibq") - pl.col("fib")).is_null().any())
            .then(None)
            .otherwise((pl.col("ibq") - pl.col("fib")).std())
        )
        .item()
    )
    out = test_results.with_columns(
        fe1=(pl.col("ibq") - pl.col("fib")) / pl.col("ibq").abs(),
        fe2=(pl.col("ibq") - pl.col("fib")) / pl.lit(denom_m2),
    )
    return out.with_columns(
        pl.col("fib", "fe1", "fe2").fill_nan(None)
    )

quarters = (
    reg_data_fos
    .filter(pl.col("qtr") >= 1974, pl.col("qtr") < 1987)
    .select("qtr")
    .unique()
    .sort("qtr")
    .to_series()
    .to_list()
)

def get_results(quarter):
    gvkeys = (
        reg_data_fos
        .filter(pl.col("qtr") == quarter)
        .select("gvkey")
        .unique()
        .to_series()
        .to_list()
    )
    out = [fit_model_fos(gvkey, quarter) for gvkey in gvkeys]
    out = [x for x in out if x is not None and x.height > 0]
    if len(out) == 0:
        return None
    return pl.concat(out, how="vertical")
```

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor

with ptime():
    with ThreadPoolExecutor() as executor:
        results = pl.concat(
            [x for x in executor.map(get_results, quarters)],
            how="vertical")

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
# All cells below this point depend on the long-running PEAD results above
deciles_inner = list(range(1, 10))

decile_ranges = (
    results
    .unpivot(
        on=["fe1", "fe2"],
        index="qtr",
        variable_name="measure",
        value_name="value",
    )
    .group_by("qtr", "measure")
    .agg(
        decile=[0] + deciles_inner + [10],
        cutoff=pl.concat_list([
            float("-inf"),
            *[pl.col("value").quantile(d / 10) for d in deciles_inner],
            float("inf"),
        ]),
    )
    .explode("decile", "cutoff")
    .sort("measure", "decile", "qtr")
    .with_columns(
        cutoff=pl.col("cutoff").shift(1).over("measure", "decile"),
    )
    .sort("qtr", "measure", "decile")
    .with_columns(
        minimum=pl.col("cutoff").shift(1).over("qtr", "measure"),
        maximum=pl.col("cutoff"),
    )
    .filter(pl.col("decile") > 0,
            pl.col("minimum").is_not_null())
    .select("qtr", "measure", "decile", "minimum", "maximum")
)

results_deciles = (
    results
    .select("gvkey", "datadateq", "qtr", "rdq", "fe1", "fe2")
    .unpivot(
        index=["gvkey", "datadateq", "qtr", "rdq"],
        on=["fe1", "fe2"],
        variable_name="measure",
        value_name="value",
    )
    .filter(pl.col("value").is_not_null())
    .join_where(
        decile_ranges,
        pl.col("qtr") == pl.col("qtr_right"),
        pl.col("measure") == pl.col("measure_right"),
        pl.col("value") > pl.col("minimum"),
        pl.col("value") <= pl.col("maximum"),
    )
    .select(
        "gvkey", "datadateq", "qtr", "rdq",
        "measure", "value", "decile"
    )
    .pivot(
        on="measure",
        index=["gvkey", "datadateq", "qtr", "rdq"],
        values=["value", "decile"],
    )
    .rename({
        "value_fe1": "fe1",
        "value_fe2": "fe2",
        "decile_fe1": "fe1_decile",
        "decile_fe2": "fe2_decile",
    })
    .lazy()
)

ccm_link = (
    ccmxpf_lnkhist
    .filter(
        pl.col("linktype").is_in(["LC", "LU", "LS"])
        & pl.col("linkprim").is_in(["C", "P"])
    )
    .with_columns(linkenddt=pl.col("linkenddt")
                            .fill_null(pl.col("linkenddt").max()))
    .rename({"lpermno": "permno"})
    .select("gvkey", "permno", "linkdt", "linkenddt")
)

pead_link = (
    results_deciles
    .select("gvkey", "rdq")
    .unique()
    .join(ccm_link, on="gvkey", how="inner")
    .filter(pl.col("rdq").is_between(pl.col("linkdt"),
                                     pl.col("linkenddt")))
    .select("gvkey", "rdq", "permno")
)

def get_event_rets(df, event_date, win_start=-1, win_end=1):

    dsf = load_parquet("dsf", "crsp")
    dsedelist = load_parquet("dsedelist", "crsp")
    erdport1 = load_parquet("erdport1", "crsp")

    trading_dates = get_trading_dates()

    annc_dates = (
        get_annc_dates()
        .select(
                pl.col("annc_date").alias(event_date),
                pl.col("td").alias("event_td"),
        )
    )

    dsedel_data = (
        dsedelist
        .rename({"dlstdt": "date"})
        .select("permno", "date", "dlret")
        .filter(pl.col("dlret").is_not_null())
    )

    rets_w_td = (
        dsf
        .select("permno", "date", "ret")
        .join(dsedel_data, on=["permno", "date"], how="full")
        .with_columns(
            ret=(
                (1 + pl.coalesce(pl.col("ret"), 0))
                * (1 + pl.coalesce(pl.col("dlret"), 0))
                - 1
            )
        )
        .join(erdport1, on=["permno", "date"], how="left")
        .select("permno", "date", "ret", "decret")
        .join(trading_dates, on="date", how="inner")
    )

    rets_data = (
        df.lazy()
        .join(annc_dates, on=event_date, how="inner")
        .join(rets_w_td, on="permno", how="inner")
        .with_columns(relative_td=pl.col("td") - pl.col("event_td"))
        .filter(pl.col("relative_td").is_between(win_start, win_end))
        .select(event_date, "permno", "date", "relative_td", "ret", "decret")
    )

    return rets_data

rets = get_event_rets(pead_link, event_date="rdq",
                      win_start=-60, win_end=60)

with ptime():
    plot_data = (
        results_deciles
        .filter(pl.col("rdq").is_not_null())
        .sort("gvkey", "rdq", "datadateq")
        .unique(subset=["gvkey", "rdq"],
                keep="last", maintain_order=True)
        .with_columns(decile=pl.col("fe2_decile"))
        .join(pead_link, on=["gvkey", "rdq"], how="inner")
        .join(rets, on=["rdq", "permno"], how="inner")
        .group_by("decile", "relative_td")
        .agg(ar=(pl.col("ret") - pl.col("decret")).mean())
        .collect()
    )
```

## Post-earnings announcement drift

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
#| label: fig-pre
#| fig-cap: Pre-announcement returns
#| fig-alt: "Plot of cumulative abnormal returns over 60 days prior to earnings announcement by earnings surprise decile."
(
    plot_data
    .filter(pl.col("relative_td") <= 0)
    .filter(pl.col("decile").is_not_null())
    .with_columns(decile=pl.col("decile").cast(pl.String))
    .sort("decile", "relative_td")
    .with_columns(
        not_first_day=pl.col("relative_td") !=
                        pl.col("relative_td").min().over("decile"),
        last_day=pl.col("relative_td") ==
                        pl.col("relative_td").max().over("decile"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.when("not_first_day").then("ar").otherwise(0.0)
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("ar").cum_sum().over("decile").alias("car"),
        pl.when("last_day").then("decile").alias("label")
    )
    .ggplot(aes(x="relative_td", y="car",
                group="decile", color="decile"))
    .geom_line()
    .geom_label(aes(label="label"), na_rm=True)
    .add_theme(legend_position="none")
)
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| eval: false
#| label: fig-post
#| fig-cap: Post-announcement returns
#| fig-alt: "Plot of cumulative abnormal returns over 60 days after earnings announcement by earnings surprise decile."
(
    plot_data
    .filter(pl.col("relative_td") >= 0)
    .filter(pl.col("decile").is_not_null())
    .with_columns(decile=pl.col("decile").cast(pl.String))
    .sort("decile", "relative_td")
     .with_columns(
        not_first_day=pl.col("relative_td") !=
                        pl.col("relative_td").min().over("decile"),
        last_day=pl.col("relative_td") ==
                        pl.col("relative_td").max().over("decile"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.when("not_first_day").then("ar").otherwise(0.0)
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("ar").cum_sum().over("decile").alias("car"),
        pl.when("last_day").then("decile").alias("label")
    )
    .ggplot(aes(x="relative_td", y="car",
                group="decile", color="decile"))
    .geom_line()
    .geom_label(aes(label="label"), na_rm=True)
    .add_theme(legend_position="none")
)
```
